made_for: issue 1752 Gate 3 (Ryan, Nov 23 2026 11:02 PM and 11:09 PM CT: more music, more variety, use the credits, prompts shaped by past waves, music on theme for each faction, new sound effects)
note: Wave F: every sound still on an old placeholder, the Gate 3 re-rolls, 16 new moments the game has no sound for yet, and 2 more takes of 27 most-heard keepers re-made from each keeper's exact recorded parameters (relay manifests) for the round robin. Wave M: a full soundtrack (calm and intense battle layers per faction from the sound playbook's faction voices, title, 6 map, 2 boss, nemesis, shop, 3 reward, 7 stings) plus one stem split test. Prompts follow plan sections 2 to 8 (identity first, one size word, banned-word list, no negative nouns, deaths centered and midrange, UI acoustic and mechanical).
